speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …ちょっと〓もう
original_en: Okay, kids. Break time.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: なんだってこんな面倒なとこに安置しやがったんだ…
original_en:
Why'd they keep it in such an out-of-
the-way place?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 神々や不死者に奪われないようにとの配〓からでしょう
original_en:
So that it would not be plundered by the
gods or the undead, no doubt.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: オーブはミッドガルドを安定させるいわば支〓ですから
original_en:
The orb is, in effect, the pillar that
supports Midgard.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: しかし思わせぶりな造りは かえって人の好〓心を〓るというもの…
original_en:
However, a place too secluded is bound
to invite the curiosity of mortals.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 何ですか それ！？
original_en: What in heavens is that!?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 盗〓者の〓でしょう
original_en: The remains of tomb raiders.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: …ディラン殿？
original_en: Sir Dylan?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …すまない 人違いだ
original_en: Sorry. Thought you were someone else.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 何だと！？
original_en: Like who!?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: ついさっき化け物にやられた死体を見たばかりで 気が立ってた
original_en:
I just saw a monster dig in to a corpse
back there, so I'm a little on edge.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: もしあんたがそうならそろそろ化けの〓がはがれてるだろ…
original_en:
But I figure if you were a monster,
you'd have peeled off your skin by now.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: アリューゼ！
original_en: Arngrim!

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …ご同業とちょっとモメただけだ
original_en: Just chatting with some colleagues.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 同業？
original_en: Colleagues?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: あんたらも宝探しだろ？
original_en: You're treasure hunting too, right?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 無礼を言うなッ！
original_en: How dare you!

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 我々はディパン公国の者だ！貴様ら盗〓者とは違う！
original_en:
We are loyal subjects of Dipan!
Don't confuse us with plunderers like you!

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 失礼したわね おっしゃる通り私達はここへ盗〓に来た者よ
original_en:
How rude of us. As you so deftly imply,
we are indeed here to "plunder" treasure.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 私はレオーネ この男はアリューゼよ
original_en: I'm Leone. This is my partner, Arngrim.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: この辺りは噂で聞いた以上に物騒ねよければご一緒願えないかしら？
original_en:
It's even hairier in here than the
rumors suggest. What do you say we
team up?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: もちろん〓物は〓半とは言わない〓対2でいいわ
original_en:
Of course, to make things fair, we'd
settle for a third.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: おい 話が違うぜ！
original_en: Hey, that's not the deal!

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: お断りだ！ そもそも我々は盗〓に来ているのではない
original_en:
Forget it! We're not here to hunt for
treasure. Be off with you.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: ディラン！
original_en: Dylan!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 目的が違うのですからご一緒していただいたほうが…
original_en:
They don't want what we want. What would
be the harm in teaming up?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: こんな素性の知れない連中と
original_en: But we barely know anything about them!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: お〓い様じゃねえの？
original_en: They could say the same about us.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: さあ 行こうぜ！
original_en: Wake up, time to go!

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 本業は傭兵だけど この平和続き宝探しで〓口をしのいでるってわけ
original_en:
But we're actually mercenaries. We hunt
treasure to make ends meet in times of
peace.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: ここに金〓〓宝が埋もれているとでも思っていたのでしょうか…
original_en:
They probably thought they'd find
treasure buried here.

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 何があったの？
original_en: What's going on?
